Federal Register 
Vol. 47, No. 74 
Friday, April 16, 1982
Presidential Documents
Title 3— Executive Order 12358 of April 14, 1982
The President Presidential Commission on Drunk Driving
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution of the United  
States of America, and in order to aid the States in their fight against the  
epidemic of drunk driving on the Nation’s roads, it is hereby ordered as  
follows:
Section 1. Establishment  There is hereby established the Presidential Com­
mission on Drunk Driving. The Commission shall be composed of no more  
than 26 members appointed by the President. In addition, the Majority Leader 
of the Senate and the Speaker of the House of Representatives are invited to  
designate two Members of each House to participate. The President shall  
designate a Chairman from among the members of the Commission.
Sec. 2. Functions. The Commission shall undertake to:
(a) heighten public awareness of the seriousness of the drunk driving problem
